From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Lydia Park <lydia@acmevc.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast latch & stage truthing — board packet readiness

Team,

We need a short, verifiable sweep of the pipeline before we lock the board packet next week. Key asks below — please treat as high priority:

- Stage truthing: update each live opportunity to one of {commit / best_case / upside} and include the single best piece of evidence (e.g., signed LOI, PO, active procurement thread) in the "stage_evidence" field on HubSpot.
- ARR tie-out: confirm booked ARR that will contribute to Q3 guidance and surface any one-off accounting adjustments. Put numbers in column "Board_ARREntries" on the attached workbook.
- Remove stale items: if an opportunity hasn't had substantive movement in 45+ days, either move it to "upside" or mark for removal; note the owner.

Attached: Q2_board_forecast_snapshot.xlsx (sheet: board_tally). I need a first-pass by EOD Monday 5/24 PT so finance can fold the figures into the narrative.

Deliverables (minimal): updated HubSpot entries + a single PDF per rep with evidence links.

Thanks — this will be short and surgical.

— Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q2_board_forecast_snapshot.xlsx (workbook stub, sheets: board_tally / assumptions / deal_notes)

Adding context on ARR math and narrative for the board:

- Net new ARR: I've reconciled the board tally sheet to CRM and adjusted for expected churn; preliminary locked corridor is $5.2M — $5.5M in incremental ARR for Q3 (this includes one-time onboarding credits removed). See tab 'assumptions' in the workbook.
- Churn adjustment: applied a conservative 1.8% sequential churn uplift across subscription accounts that had payment issues flagged in April.
- Commit criteria: for the board packet, we're using: signed PO / final SOW + legal review email OR active invoice in AR system. Any deals without either move to 'best_case'.

I started a short narrative paragraph for the board slide: "Pipeline tightened after stage truthing: commit corridor reflects only fully evidenced deals — supporting a conservative ARR outlook while leaving room for upside should purchase orders arrive before the packet lock." Will refine once Ben's deal drill lands.

Also FYI: DocuSign for Deal HD-10234 is in-flight (link below). If that signs before Monday we'll pull it into commit.

Marissa
Director, FP&A

1) Can you confirm the "commit" definition in one sentence in the board appendix? We want to be able to map to the ARR corridor in our notes.
2) Please attach a single evidence PDF per commit-opportunity (signed doc or procurement thread screenshot) to the shared drive link by 9:00 AM PT Monday 5/24. That way our team can reconcile before the deck goes to the board.

Otherwise, please flag any deals you plan to leave in 'best_case' that are >$250k ARR.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — let me know if your timeline slips.
